rules.title: Tracked target documents must follow their declared source
rules.text: When a source file declared in .gate-keeper/dependency-manifest.yml changes in a PR, every target document that tracks it must change too — or a reviewer ack at .gate-keeper/acks/<edge-id>.yml must cover the current source sha. The validator dispatches by `to:` path, so this rule covers every manifest edge when invoked with the matching --target.

rules.title: Repo-local references in text-bearing files must resolve and be classified
rules.text: Issue #269 slice 1. Walks the target text-bearing file (README / docs / config / rule file), extracts repo-local file/path/doc references, and emits deterministic findings for each category that fires: `broken_reference` (referenced path missing), `uncovered_reference` / `newly_introduced` (a new repo-local reference relative to baseline, not yet covered by a manifest edge), and `suspicious_broad` (glob, trailing slash, or bare top-level directory). Detection + reporting only; manifest-coverage enforcement and LLM-rubric narrowing are explicitly later slices.

rules.title: Changed files must have a manifest edge or an explicit exemption
rules.text: Issue #280 slice 2. For each changed file in a PR, requires either (a) at least one manifest edge in .gate-keeper/dependency-manifest.yml whose from/to node resolves to that path, or (b) an explicit entry in .gate-keeper/ref-exemptions.yml. Uncovered changed files emit uncovered_file (FAIL). Covered files emit covering_edge (PASS). Exempted files emit exemption_applied (PASS). Files not in the changed-file set are silently passed as dependent_artifact_unaffected. Fail-closed on unreadable manifest, unreadable/malformed exemption file, or unavailable git diff.
